note: Defects injected into the generated MongoDB shop, so the ecommerce contention criteria are proven on the backend they score rather than only on PostgreSQL. Anchors are specific to this app; regenerate for another.

mutations.desc: Remove the quantity guard from the atomic stock decrement. The app reserves stock with findOneAndUpdate({_id, quantity: {$gte: take}}, {$inc: {quantity: -take}}) — the filter is what makes the decrement safe under concurrency, because a document whose stock has already been taken no longer matches. Without it the update always applies and simultaneous buyers each decrement the same units.
Remove the per-user lock around checkout so two simultaneous checkouts of one cart both read its lines and each create an order.
